official_sources.title: Load in-app content
observed: Packaged content need not access the internet
WebViewAssetLoader supports same-origin HTTP(S) local resources
loadDataWithBaseURL is an alternative for an HTML page without subresource interception
file/data opaque origins and universal/file access workarounds are discouraged; explicit false recommended
Mixed content always-allow is discouraged
official_sources.application_proposal: Reuse frozen editor HTML/JS/CSS with a real offline I/O adapter. Prefer an already available AssetLoader dependency; otherwise evaluate a bounded self-contained framework alternative without assuming new dependencies.
official_sources.unverified: Existing AndroidX WebKit availability, installed WebView behavior, app build and large photo performance

official_sources.title: Access documents and other files from shared storage
read_sections: Persist permissions and unknown document sizes
observed: User-selected documents via system picker and URI grants
ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT creates a new document rather than overwriting an existing name
ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT selects a supported document
Provider capabilities/size may vary
Persistable permission does not survive file move/deletion without re-selection
official_sources.application_proposal: Use native document open/create flows, private local draft first, stream-limited input, explicit final write result and cancellation/error preservation. Prefer local provider when offline.
official_sources.unverified: Actual OEM picker behavior, file copy route, URI revocation/disk-full handling and complete phone-to-PC round trip

official_sources.title: WebView – Native bridges
observed: addJavascriptInterface exposes an object to all frames and lacks caller-origin validation
Untrusted injected content can misuse a native bridge
Message channels also require an exact trusted origin
Load scoped app-owned content and avoid exposing sensitive general-purpose native operations
official_sources.application_proposal: Deny external navigation/subresources/frames, treat imported values as data rather than HTML or code, keep native file actions minimal and validate every message/schema/size. Do not solve file loading by broad WebView privileges.
official_sources.unverified: Chosen native-to-editor channel and real application attack-surface tests

official_sources.title: Zip Path Traversal
observed: java.util.zip does not make archive entry paths safe automatically
Extraction can overwrite files outside the intended directory
Target paths must remain under a safe destination and existing content should not be overwritten
official_sources.application_proposal: Prefer streaming fixed allowlisted entries rather than arbitrary path extraction; validate manifest/photo content, declared and actual bounds, traversal and duplicate entries, and stage imports without overwriting originals.
official_sources.unverified: Chosen ZIP contract, actual member/compression limits and corruption/adversarial-file tests; additional bounds are design requirements, not claimed as supplied by the standard library

official_sources.unverified: Manual standalone build, signing, installation and device behavior not executed by documentation author

implementation_inferences: Existing server-backed HTML is not offline merely because it is packaged in a WebView
Phone should edit source-coordinate data locally; unavailable PC Python/AI/Blender calculations remain deferred to PC import
Photos/part IDs, displayed-image orientation, SHA256, base revisions and baseline digest are necessary to prevent wrong-project or stale overwrites
PC import must preview a staged candidate, recheck revisions when applying, deduplicate change sets and invalidate changed measurement confirmations
Local draft saved, exported file written and PC import applied are distinct states; there is no automatic PC sync claim
